fact: The ECOWAS Commission, with Guinean authorities and disability organisations, met in Conakry in June 2026 on implementing the third phase of its assistive-devices programme for children with disabilities, which covers specialised tablets among other devices and has USD 300,000 committed.

Guinea's Ministry of Planning launched the Lonnin Fanka programme on 27 June 2025, which aims to give every Guinean, including people with disabilities, a computer, internet access and certified training.
